subject: Aspire Health — Renewal: commit uplift + price-hold request
messages:
From: Emily Ward <emily.ward@aspirehealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal inquiry — Aspire capacity + pricing hold request

Hi Tessa,

Hope you’re well. Aspire's finance team has started the renewal planning cycle and asked me to get a formal renewal proposal on file. We're looking to:  
- Increase committed capacity by ~20% year-over-year (mainly embeddings + chat throughput)  
- Secure a 6–9 month price-hold on current unit rates while we finalize budget approvals  
- Receive a one-time credit bucket to cover any transitional overages during the migration to the latest integration (we estimate ~10k tokens during ramp)

Can you share an updated quote and confirm whether Redwood can offer a temporary price-hold and credits tied to the new commit? Attached is our procurement_form.pdf with procurement contacts and billing info.

We'd like to close commercial terms by Nov 15 to align with our procurement window. Happy to jump on a 30-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Emily Ward
Head of Vendor Ops
Aspire Health
attachments: procurement_form.pdf
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-02T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal inquiry — Aspire capacity + pricing hold request

Hi Emily — thanks for the details and the procurement form.  

We can absolutely put together a structured renewal that hits those asks. High-level options I recommend (we'll put formal numbers in the attached commercial_summary_v1.xlsx):

1) 12-month commit + staged uplift (recommended)
   - Commit to 20% uplift vs current baseline
   - 6-month firm price-hold at current unit rates, then a 3-month phased index if usage exceeds committed thresholds
   - One-time transition credit: 10k tokens (applied as usage credit over first billing cycle)

2) 24-month commit (better unit economics)
   - Deeper discount on committed units, 9-month price-hold, credits as above

3) Short-term bridge (6 months)
   - Smaller commit, burst buffer credits, tailored for procurement delays

We will also include a tiered overage rate (so you have predictability beyond committed volume) and a guardrail that limits per-token price movement during the hold period. I’ve attached a commercial_summary_v1.xlsx with the draft numbers and a suggested mutual action plan (MAP).

Next steps:  
- If you confirm which option you prefer, Ben (cc'd) will prepare the final commercial and I’ll loop in Monica for onboarding/CS transition items.
- I can also provide SOC2 evidence and the security checklist; Monica, can you take point on that?

Happy to set up a 30-min slot — propose Nov 4 or Nov 5 morning PT.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
attachments: commercial_summary_v1.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-03T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal inquiry — Aspire capacity + pricing hold request

Emily — quick commercial note from my side:  

Appreciate the timeline. A few guardrails to call out so procurement has visibility:  
- Larger upfront commits materially reduce unit price; we can flow-through a 6–9% effective discount for the 20% uplift under a 24-month commit.  
- For a 12-month deal with a 6-month price-hold, we’d recommend a small non-refundable onboarding credit (applied to the first invoice) to cover burst risk — suggested $2,500 equivalent.  
- Overage rate cap: we can cap overage increases to +10% of committed blended rate for the first 3 months after the hold.

If Aspire is constrained on term, consider splitting the uplift: 10% committed now + option to convert an additional 10% mid-year with a pre-agreed rate schedule. That preserves flexibility and protects Redwood’s capacity planning.

Happy to walk through the numbers in the attached sheet.

—Ben
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aspirehealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Emily Ward <emily.ward@aspirehealth.com>, procurement@aspirehealth.com
Date: 2026-11-05T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal inquiry — Aspire capacity + pricing hold request

Tessa / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround. Couple of clarifications and a counter-proposal from our finance/procurement side:  

1) Commit: willing to firm up a 15% uplift immediately and commit to an additional optional 5% within the first 6 months (total 20% if exercised).
2) Price-hold: ask for a 6-month price-hold on current unit rates (not phased), with an option to extend an additional 3 months if usage growth stays within the committed path.
3) Credits: would prefer a single transitional credit (Aspire requests 12k tokens) and that any onboarding fee be absorbed into a one-time service credit rather than a separate cash payment.
4) Security: can you provide the SOC2 Type II attestation and an updated security checklist? We’ve attached a signed_SOW_v1.pdf for our expected integration scope — please confirm it aligns with your onboarding plan.

We can approve commercial terms by Nov 12 if legal and security are satisfied. Please put the final MAP and link to the DocuSign in the reply.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Director, Procurement
Aspire Health

Team — thank you. Per your counter-proposal, we can proceed with the following mutually actionable plan (MAP) and I'll get the formal contract ready for signature:  

MAP (summary):
- Commit: 15% firm uplift effective on renewal start date + opt-in to convert additional 5% within 180 days with pre-agreed pricing schedule.
- Price-hold: 6 months firm at current unit rates. If the optional 5% is exercised, the hold extends only for the additional volume; the baseline stays at 6 months.
- Transitional credit: 12k tokens applied as a first-invoice usage credit.
- Onboarding fee: converted to a one-time service credit (applied to implementation invoice).
- Overage protection: overage rate capped at +10% of committed blended rate for first 90 days after hold expiration.
- Security deliverables: Monica will send SOC2 Type II PDF and updated security checklist by EOD Nov 10.

Commercial artifacts & next steps:
- I’ve uploaded the final commercial summary to HubSpot and created deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/DEAL-2026-ASP-561
- Draft contract + SOW will be issued via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/ABCDEF-aspire-renewal (expect within 24 hours)
- Requested internal approvals: Ben is taking commercial; Markus (cc'd) will sign off on executive discount exceptions if needed.
- Closing target: Nov 12 (to meet your procurement window).

Monica — can you confirm the security attachments and share a short onboarding timeline (2–3 bullets) we can include in the SOW?

Emily / Liam — please reply with any final commercial redlines. If none, I’ll issue DocuSign and we’ll route to legal.

Best regards,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
